# fraud/ (PRD-05 Phase 11 — cross-tenant supplier graph + fraud signals)

## Endpoints
- `POST /api/accounting/fraud/scan` — manually run fraud scan for this company
- `GET /api/accounting/fraud/signals` — list alerts (`?status=&limit=` — limit clamped 1..500, default 100)
- `POST /api/accounting/fraud/[id]/confirm` — mark alert confirmed
- `POST /api/accounting/fraud/[id]/dismiss` — dismiss, body `{ reason? }`

## Auth
`withAuth(withErrorHandler(withWriteAccess(...)))` on `scan`, `confirm`, `dismiss`. `withAuth(withErrorHandler(...))` on `signals` (read-only).

## Request / Response
- `signals` response: `{ alerts, total }`
- `confirm`/`dismiss` require `req.user.id` (attributed to reviewer)
- UUID regex guards `[id]` param before DB

## Business rules
- Cross-tenant signals: supplier graph spans companies but the API only surfaces signals for the caller's `company_id`
- Confirm/dismiss are idempotent-style — return `{ confirmed: true }` / `{ dismissed: true }`
- Scan is synchronous via service; service decides rate of work internally

## Related files
- `src/modules/accounting/services/capture/supplierGraphService.ts` — scan/list/confirm/dismiss + cross-tenant correlation
